name: v2src-routew75
desc: ROUTING, WIDENED. `coatnet_w.__default__` 0.60 -> 0.75, moving the SEVEN findings upstream's 22 probes never touched (MCL, Medial OA, PF OA, Effusion, Synovitis, Baker's, Contusion) toward the CoAtNet arm. The measured dose-response says more CoAtNet is better and macro-AUC weights all twelve labels equally, so the untouched seven are the largest untested area in the RUN config. Paired with `routew85`.
